# netapp-storagegrid_grid_product_version (Data Source)

Reads the StorageGRID software version. It is also a simple way to check that a connection profile works.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_product_version" "version" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
}

output "storagegrid_version" {
  value = data.netapp-storagegrid_grid_product_version.version.product_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name. The profile must be a grid profile, without `account_id`.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) Version of the management API used by the provider for this connection profile, for example `v4`.
- `product_version` (String) StorageGRID software version, for example `11.9.0`.
